recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core FHIR follow-up is needed; future changes to designNote contexts or SDC profile usage should be handled in the Extension Pack or SDC repositories.
issue_request: FHIR-13933 requested a design-purpose note field for Questionnaire.item. The Published/Persuasive with Modification resolution was to add a designNote extension of type markdown, cardinality 0..1, with contexts Questionnaire and Questionnaire.item, include it as optional in SDC, and seek later feedback on broader infrastructure-resource contexts.
initial_application: The issue appears to have been applied by b8c5990ac5/SVN #14772, which added designNote to the Questionnaire extension spreadsheet with Questionnaire contexts, 0..1 cardinality, markdown value, and design-comments prose.
additional_context: FHIR-17660 later broadened the same extension by moving it into general extensions and adding ElementDefinition context; that related issue is already audited on the combined branch. Core then removed extension rows from R5 source, while the current Extension Pack owns StructureDefinition-designNote.xml. A 2023 Questionnaire Zulip thread and Extension Pack commit e8caaab show the old Questionnaire.item.item context was intentionally removed as unnecessary.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. Current core source retains only the designNote OID, while the active Extension Pack definition has id/url designNote, markdown value, max 1, and contexts Questionnaire, Questionnaire.item, and ElementDefinition. Current SDC source includes designNote 0..1 at the Questionnaire root and under item.
